main_text.p: eum illis naturæ sit, sive unde dimanarunt,) una fecum illorum Comites & quicquid illis adhæret & agglutinatur, auferre. Pag. 590.
main_text.head: Ad Magnum Inclytumque Virum,
D. ANTONIUM DEUSINGIUM, Medicum longe Celeberrimum, &c Philosophum Incomparabilem,
ANTONIUS DEUSINGIUS. Anagramma,
DIVINUS SONAT GENIUS. EN DIGNUS JOVIS NATUS.
main_text.p: PErmitte noftrum Te quoque barbiton Cantare Magnum Depositum Poli, Permitte, Tu nec fperne noftra Nablia, plectra, chelyn, lyramque; Cantemus etsi non humili nisi Buxo, sonoram vel citharam manu

page.notes: Some words in the verse are faint or the printed hyphenation is uncertain; the lines "Buxo, sonoram" and "Pulsemus" are read from a worn scan. The head "Ad Magnum..." is set in italic initial letters. The first line of the index fragment is partly cut at the left edge.
